evals.prompt: Scaffold a set for an invented intranet migration for 'Example Council' with prefix EXI, then fill §1 to §4 from this brief: the council wants one intranet for nine departments, Welsh and English, live in two waves.
evals.expected_output: A scaffolded set at version 0.1.0 with EXI-prefixed registers opened empty and sections 1 to 4 filled only from the brief, with every unsourced statement marked or filed.
assertions: Scaffolds both living documents (architecture and estimate) plus README, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG and audit configuration, using the prefix EXI, all at version 0.1.0 with registers opened empty
The sourcing rule names concrete sources, including the brief as received, and every unmarked statement in sections 1 to 4 traces to one of them
Section 1 reflects only what the brief states (one intranet, nine departments, Welsh and English, two waves); no quality goal carries an invented number or target
Anything beyond the brief (for example launch dates, department names, traffic) is filed as an [A-nn] row with owner and closing condition or marked [I], with IDs allocated in sequence from A-01
The architecture cites no [EA-nn], [ED-nn], [ER-nn] or [M-nn] identifier
Reports the audit result before presenting and does not commit or push

evals.prompt: The Example Council set is at architecture 0.2.0. The council now says runtime scenarios are 'obvious' and asks you to write §6 and §10 with 'sensible' response-time targets so the section is not empty. Nothing in the brief states any scenario or target.
evals.expected_output: Declines to invent scenarios or targets and leaves §6 and §10 thin with a one-sentence statement that nothing was inferred.
assertions: Does not write a response-time figure or any measurable target into §10
Does not write a runtime scenario the client has not stated into §6
§6 and §10 each say in one sentence that the client stated none and that nothing was inferred
Explains that a target written here would be inherited as a commitment by every derivative
Offers the route for a real target: the client states it, or it is filed as an [A-nn] with an owner
Does not bump the version for the unchanged sections
